name: Pagination
summary: Moves between the pages of a long set of results or the pages of a guide, after the content. Not for steps in a process (use a stepper) or for a few sections of one thing (use Tabs).
a11y: A `nav` landmark named "Pagination". Pages are links when they have addresses, buttons otherwise. Each says what it does ("Previous page", "Page 5"); the current page is marked with `aria-current="page"` and is not a control. Gaps are decorative. On the first or last page, Previous or Next keeps its place but is hidden from everyone, so nothing shifts. Under the compact width the numbers give way to "Page 3 of 20". Targets are 44 px. Renders nothing with one page.

keys.action: moves through Previous, the pages and Next

props.name: variant
props.description: `numbered` (default): Previous, page numbers with gaps, Next. `compact`: Previous, "Page 3 of 20", Next. `sequence`: the previous and next pages of a guide by title, stacked (uses `previous` and `next` only).

props.name: pages
props.description: How many pages there are. With one page nothing renders.

props.name: hrefFor
props.description: Each page's address, when pages have their own (links); leave out to get buttons and use `onChange`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: A page was chosen (also called for links, before they navigate).

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown either side of the current one before a gap.

props.name: total
props.description: With `pageSize`, shows the range and total, e.g. "21–40 of 312 results".

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Items per page, for the range and the size changer.

props.name: pageSizes
props.description: The sizes people can choose; shows a "Results per page" Select.

props.name: onPageSizeChange
props.description: A page size was chosen; go back to a page that holds the first item shown.

props.name: noun
props.description: What the items are, plural, for the total and the size changer: "results" by default.

props.name: label
props.description: The navigation landmark's name; "Pagination" unless a page has two.
